title: Surreal Teardrop Sculptures
description: Three large teardrop-shaped sculptures sit on a wooden table under a stormy purple sky with falling rain. The left green one and central purple one are cracked with blue and purple liquid pooling beneath them, while the right orange one appears fractured; blue laser beams strike the green and purple forms, causing sparks, as papers with diagrams, an inkwell, and a quill lie scattered nearby.
prompt: A surreal scene on a wooden table under a dark purple stormy sky with rain falling. Three large cracked teardrop-shaped sculptures: a green one on the left leaking blue liquid, a tall purple one in the center dripping purple liquid, and an orange one on the right with fracture lines. Blue laser beams hit the green and purple sculptures creating sparks. Scattered on the table are papers with geometric diagrams, a small green inkwell, and a quill pen. Dramatic lighting, painterly style with visible brushstrokes.
